claims.quote: Ageneiosus polystictus is endemic to Brazil, described for the Rio Negro, with occurrences in other blackwater drainages such as the Uatumã, Jaú, Nhamundá (Amazonas state) and Juruti (Pará state) rivers, all in the middle Amazon.
